correctness.rationale: For (i,j) blue vertices in the size-a and size-two parts, the next-round increments are independently Bin(a-i,j/2) and Bin(2-j,i/a). Removing the positive-probability self-loop yields an exact triangular recurrence. Direct rational certification for all a=3..11 shows H_0<7/2<T_A, independently checked with labelled-subset transition matrices for a=2..6. For a>=12 the small-part start has expectation at most ceil(log_2 a)+3 by coupling to a independent Geom(1/2) clocks, whereas the larger-part start needs at least a^2/(2a-1)+1 rounds. An elementary dyadic inequality separates those bounds for every a>=12. Monotone coupling supplies the matching upper comparison T_A<=a^2/(2a-1)+T_B and the a/2+O(log a) difference. The a=2 equality is exact.

value.rationale: This establishes an infinite, motivated slice of a stated 2026 open source-location conjecture, with a sharp first-order growth law a/2 for the advantage. Its two-sided proof explains the structural mechanism: a large-part start must wait geometrically for activation of the smaller part, but a small-part start initiates independent infections in the large part immediately. This also contrasts with an earlier opposite conjecture in a genuinely different forcing dynamics; it is not a textbook identity or a tabular recomputation.
